text: The proper-study validator deliberately forbids another provider’s liturgical leaf as a sealed source owner. Do not weaken that boundary. The Claude verified.md file was an untrusted transcription lead, not a controlling authority after this run independently collated every adopted unit against AAS 1925, the 1962 Missal, Lasance and 1862 Pustet. Remove the Claude path from research/review-dependencies.toml; keep the cross-provider transcription contribution and exact lead path disclosed in propers/verified.md and research/scope.md, with the primary witnesses bound and sealed. A lead consulted during research is not an adopted external source owner.
